name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Watermelon Ice
description: Sweet, icy, and seriously smooth, Watermelon Ice puts a frosty twist on a fan-favorite flavor. Juicy watermelon comes through up front, balanced by a cool, refreshing exhale that keeps things crisp without overpowering. This limited-edition 2g disposable offers an easygoing high and a clean, chilled-out finish—perfect for winter hangs, post-sesh relaxation, or anytime you want summer sweetness with a winter edge.
